title: On the True Faith, to the Empresses Pulcheria and Eudocia
edition: Pusey, Sancti patris nostri Cyrilli archiepiscopi Alexandrini De recta fide ad reginas (Oxford, 1877)
blurb: Cyril’s court treatise on right faith for Pulcheria and Eudocia (CPG 5220). One Son who suffers in flesh yet remains impassible as God. English from Pusey’s Greek.
first_english_note: Original English Translation — no previous complete free English. The English here is new from Pusey’s Greek.

text_history.method: English follows Pusey’s 1877 Greek of De recta fide ad Pulcheriam et Eudociam. OCR of that print was cleaned section by section before Pass A/B. This is a reading translation for study, not a new critical edition.
